{{Capricorn}}
Capricorn 6 is the 34th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 6th day of Capricorn, and it is a Saturday. It corresponds to ISO week 5, weekday 6.

Its informal Japanese name is 2宮6日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 34|Chapter 34]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152054}}.
